tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: The EvaFarm node catalog with live status (available / busy / reserved / maintenance / ai — busy with an AI workload until `status_until`, not for rent), hardware, hourly price and installed software and render engines. Filter to find a machine for a job.

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Full details of one node by its label, e.g. "NODE_03" (also accepts "3" or "node 3").

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Price a rental the way EvaFarm bills it: per active minute, rounded up, no minimum; node preparation is not billed. Give a duration (hours and/or minutes) or a render (frames × seconds_per_frame measured on that kind of node). With a node label the estimate uses its rate; without one it prices every

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: How many nodes are available, busy, reserved, in maintenance or busy with AI right now.

tools.name: rental_guide
tools.description: How to start renting on EvaFarm: sign-in, projects and wallets, billing rules, connecting via AnyDesk/RustDesk, teams, privacy, and the links to the app, the site and support.
